{{Top|leg}}
'''Zelosian wine''' was a type of beverage that was presumably alcoholic in nature. ([[Alcohol/Legends|Alcohol]] had no intoxicating effect on [[Zelosian]]s, but refined [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] had a comparable one; a tablespoon would have affected Zelosians as four ounces of strong liquor might affect a Human.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref>)

Zelosian wine was served on the [[Red Moon Saloon]] at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was also involved in a major incident at the bar one night that resulted in Jabba's Force-sensitive Gamorrean guardsmen and Gamorrean brothers [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] and [[Gorc]] getting arrested by [[Sariss|the Prophetess]], involving seven barrels of the [[Wine/Legends|wine]] itself, Thok, Gorc, five fricasseed [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], three bludgeoned-to-death [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], and a [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]].
